user.title: Pair DayKit
user.description:
Scan this QR code with the DayKit app (Settings > Pair):

![Pairing QR code]({qr_data_uri})

Can't scan? Enter this code manually instead: {code}

Valid for 5 minutes. You can also finish setup and pair later from the device page.

init.title: DayKit
init.description: Pick a section to configure. Everything you change here is sent to the app, which shows an update message so you can accept it - the phone stays in charge.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Shared list of handy entities. New entries show up in the app as an update message.

speaker.title: Alarm speaker
speaker.description: Speaker used for the calendar alarm, including the Home Assistant watchdog that steps in when the phone is unreachable.

presence.title: Presence
presence.description: Which entity tells us whether you are home, and which state means 'home'.

out_of_bed.title: Out of bed
out_of_bed.description: Optional check that keeps the alarm going until you are actually out of bed.

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.description: Scripts to run when an alarm or timer goes off.

data.alarm_script_ignore_presence: Run on alarm even when away
data.timer_script_ignore_presence: Run on timer even when away

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Alarm-wide settings that do not belong to one speaker.
